Alice (FinOps): Quick sync — follow-up from the token variance postmortem. We still need explicit owners and concrete deadlines for: invoice corrections, delayed-ingest fixes, recurrence detection, and customer comms. saw +12% token delta for 4 accounts because of delayed batch replays.
Ben (Eng): I can own the ingest-side fix and a verification run. plan: patch + smoke test today, full backfill on staging tomorrow.
Carol (Metering): I’ll take the recurrence detection rule and alerts. Propose two tiers: P1 (>=10% deviation in 1h) -> page, P2 (>=5% in 24h) -> slack.
Dilip (SRE): I’ll own the ledger reconcile steps and the invoice reissue pipeline integration with finance. Need playbook updated with run commands and a rollback plan.
Alice (FinOps): Nice. Can we put deadlines? Ben — ingest patch by EOD today? Carol — detection rules by Fri AM? Dilip — reissue playbook + a dry run next Tue?
Ben (Eng): EOD patch ok. Quick query I’ll run to validate deltas:
```
SELECT customer_id, SUM(tokens) as tokens, date_trunc('hour', ts) as hr
FROM token_events
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY customer_id, hr
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
Ben (Eng): Will post results in this thread after smoke.
Carol (Metering): For alerting I’ll add a short-term guard to avoid noisy pages: require 2 consecutive buckets OR >5000 token delta. Will add notebook with examples.
Dilip (SRE): For ledger reconcile I need a list of impacted invoices/customers. Alice can you dump the customer list and attach? Also will script the reissue to include pro-rated credits.
Alice (FinOps): attaching CSV to the ticket in JIRA: FIN-448 (attached). Also tagging customers for outreach: we’ll draft templates once Dilip confirms numbers.
metering-bot: Invoice Reissue Job queued: job_id=jr-20240429-57 status=queued (FIN-448).
Ben (Eng): smoke on staging passed. differences look isolated to two shard windows. posting logs: `ingest_worker_42: processed 45k events, 0 errors`
Carol (Metering): detection rule PR opened: github.com/redwood/meters/pull/412. Requesting review from @Ben and @Dilip.
Dilip (SRE): Reconcile script draft at //ops/reconcile/scripts/reissue_dryrun.sh — will run dry-run Mon 10:00 UTC.
Alice (FinOps): Owners and deadlines recap: Ben - ingest patch + staging smoke (today) and prod backfill (tomorrow). Carol - detection rules and alert thresholds (Fri AM). Dilip - reconcile script + dry-run (Mon 10:00 UTC) and reissue playbook (next Tue). Finance will prepare customer comms after dry-run.
Ben (Eng): noted. I’ll also add a lightweight metric to track late-batch latency distribution.
Carol (Metering): Will add dashboards and a Grafana alert.
Dilip (SRE): If dry-run looks good I’ll tag for production window Wed.
Alice (FinOps): Thanks — please post short status updates here as each milestone completes. I’ll update FIN-448 and move to "postmortem actions" once everything is closed. :+1:
